title: The Extra Biscuit That Was Not Yours
youtube_title: The Extra Biscuit That Was Not Yours | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Honest words let a friend help with the repair.
summary: At a library table by the round window, Noemi is tangled up with an extra biscuit that had not been offered and almost hides it. Noemi tells Miss Dalca the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
